snapshot_digest.encoding: ASCII with actual LF; lower-case hex

semantics.scope: exact local demo_fast only; existing identity/tenant/chat/plugin permissions; no new auth
semantics.authority: Same owned pipe/hello and Host instance/Native epoch matching as market-host. Renderer never sends hashes, roles, paths or scope. Structurally valid fields are not authority.
semantics.draft: No pre-created empty native thread. Draft-only binding stays Native until first accepted send. expert_apply_binding requires a true owned existing rollout; no synthetic thread UUID.
semantics.binding: CAS on expectedBindingRevision under shared session/model/thread operation lock; new revision expected+1. Pending send, running turn, pending approval/input, cleanup or unknown outbox/apply forbids changes. Read original operation; no replacement on uncertainty.
semantics.submission: Versioned wrapper references original complete market submission plus TurnExpertSnapshot. Same operation and full typed wrapper replay original receipt before any apply/prepare/Runtime work. Private snapshot turnOperationId must match original market snapshot. Do not dispatch wrapper via legacy bare submit.
semantics.grant: Reuse existing grant lifetime, revocation, epoch and one-use enforcement. expert_submit consumes only expert_grant_register grants; ordinary submit cannot consume them and vice versa. No added HTTP endpoint or parallel pipe.
semantics.composition: Full model intent, permissionMode, market snapshot plus expert revision form combined intent. Apply does not renew prior-turn market capabilities or grant tools. Every subsequent submit freezes current expert or explicit none. Model/permission/market switches preserve the same confirmed expert reference.
semantics.resources: Use managed bundle/receipt. Expert resources do not enter global Skill roots. No caller paths/role text. Retain referenced immutable bytes; if existing core cannot retain versions, block referenced upgrades/removal.
semantics.rollback: Keep old ordinary family unchanged, feature-off readers do not downgrade expert outboxes. Preserve compatible readers/history and original unknown states; no forced exit, DB downgrade or automatic resend.
semantics.result: Host applied receipt is protocol evidence, not Runtime checksum echo or model-quality PASS. Native validates actual existing thread identity and lifecycle qualification before success.
semantics.timeouts: Per-method bounded budgets on the existing serial pipe; Native response wait exceeds Host method budget. expert_submit includes the existing 20s submission deadline plus at most 5s normal settlement. Expiry preserves unknown intent; no replacement operation, automatic retry, process respawn or forced termination.
semantics.resource_operations: Managed core install/uninstall and original durable operation receipt, serialized with binding/submission under the same Native admission and Host model-operation locks. Prepare/remove use trusted current scope and exact catalog selection; Native forbids removal referenced by any retained binding/submission, Host also checks live references. Reads never reinstall or resubmit. Original completed receipt is replayed before current admission or resource state. No renderer paths, role text, digests or grant authority.
semantics.status: Read-only, current-owned-scope status reports the verified catalog digest and actual configured expert adapter support. Native matches its pinned catalog, never infers execution readiness from a UI flag or a guessed missing-operation error.
semantics.explicit_recovery: Only a deliberate recover command may reconcile an unsettled original operation. Renderer supplies original operation identity only; Native loads its immutable generated request and supplies current authority separately. Current write authorization, original scope/intent identity, shared admission locks and normal idle/approval/outbox guards are mandatory. Binding recovery re-applies the exact original composition to the same verified existing thread, preserving original receipt identity and revision; it cannot renew turn grants or send a turn. Resource recovery never installs/removes: it observes the original managed-core journal or durably rejects a provably unstarted core operation while excluding an active owner. Missing original Host binding intent requires the same original revision/thread admission; missing resource intent is never success. Completed original receipts replay first. Read/reopen/repeated set or prepare remain query-only. A recovery timeout or guard rejection keeps the original unknown state; no new operation, blanket unlock, database reset, automatic retry or security override.

knowledge_digest.encoding: UTF-8: domain + LF + decimal resource count + LF; sort resources by ASCII id; for each field append decimal UTF-8 byte length + ASCII colon + exact UTF-8 bytes; append LF after each resource
knowledge_digest.bytesField: bytes is canonical unsigned decimal text
